# archestra_service_account_api_key (Resource)

Revocable credential for a service account; the secret is returned only on creation and stored in sensitive Terraform state. Import adopts metadata and cannot recover the secret. Destroy revokes this token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_service_account_api_key" "example" {
  service_account_id = archestra_service_account.example.id
  name               = "Deployment credential"
  expires_in         = 86400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Token display name.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account that owns the token.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether this credential is disabled.
- `expires_at` (String) Explicit absolute expiry timestamp; removing a previously configured value clears the expiry.
- `expires_in` (Number) Creation-time lifetime in seconds; changing it issues a replacement token.
- `rotation_nonce` (String) Change this declaration to revoke and replace the credential.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Token creation timestamp.
- `effective_expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp currently stored by the API.
- `id` (String) Composite service-account UUID and token UUID.
- `last_used_at` (String) Most recent authentication time.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret returned only on creation.
- `token_start` (String) Non-secret prefix identifying the token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_service_account_api_key.example service_account_uuid:token_uuid
```
